one_line: A Late Harappan village woman from the Ghaggar-Hakra region, living through the gradual transformation of the Indus civilisation.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but sturdy build from daily labor
appearance.face: soft oval face with medium-brown complexion, straight nose, full but firm lips, slightly arched brows and large expressive dark-brown eyes; a few faint freckles and sun-kissed cheeks; default expression calm, observant and quietly determined.
appearance.hair: thick straight black hair parted in the center, oiled and drawn back into a single long braid reaching mid-back, wrapped at the base with a narrow terracotta-red cloth band; no elaborate headdress, only a simple thin copper headband sitting low across the forehead.
appearance.costume: She wears an era-accurate Harappan-style wrapped lower garment: an unstitched, ankle-length cotton cloth in muted indigo with a narrow off-white border, wrapped sari-like around the waist and pleated neatly to the left; on top, a short-sleeved, hip-length woven cotton tunic in warm buff-beige, slightly loose but modest, with a simple round neckline and a subtle vertical stripe texture; over one shoulder is a draped shawl of lightweight undyed cotton with a faint diagonal weave, pinned at the right shoulder with a small copper pin so it can cover her chest when she moves; her feet are in plain brown leather sandals with simple straps; jewelry is modest but distinctively Harappan: a multi-strand necklace of red carnelian and white shell beads, a single prominent steatite bead at the center, a pair of small copper hoop earrings, three thin copper bangles on her right wrist, and a few terracotta bead bangles on her left; she has a narrow cloth belt at the waist, dyed terracotta-red, from which a tiny clay seal-amulet pouch hangs.
appearance.signature: A well-used, slightly curved copper sickle with a simple wooden handle, tied at her waist on the left side with a short cord so it rests against her hip, its greenish patina hinting at long use in harvesting and cutting reeds.

ref_desc: Rakhigarhi Woman is a lean, medium-brown Late Harappan villager with a calm oval face, long center-parted black hair in a single braid, wearing an indigo wrapped lower cloth, buff-beige tunic, off-white shawl, modest Harappan jewelry, and a patinated copper sickle at her hip with terracotta-red accents.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of the Rakhigarhi Woman: a mid-20s, lean but sturdy Late Harappan villager with a medium-brown complexion, soft oval face, straight nose, full lips, and large dark-brown eyes, her expression calm and observant. Her thick straight black hair is center-parted and drawn back into a single long braid to mid-back, secured at the base with a narrow terracotta-red cloth band and a thin copper headband sitting low across her forehead. She wears an ankle-length muted indigo wrapped cotton lower garment with a narrow off-white border, wrapped sari-like and pleated to the left, a hip-length short-sleeved woven cotton tunic in warm buff beige with a simple round neckline, and an off-white lightweight shawl draped over one shoulder and pinned at the right with a small copper pin so it modestly covers her chest. Add plain brown leather sandals with simple straps. Show her Harappan jewelry clearly: multi-strand red carnelian and white shell bead necklace with one central steatite bead, small copper hoop earrings, three thin copper bangles on the right wrist, several terracotta bead bangles on the left, and a terracotta-red cloth belt with a tiny clay seal-amulet pouch at her waist. Her signature prop is a slightly curved copper sickle with a wooden handle, hanging at her left hip with a greenish patina from long use. Use a palette dominated by muted indigo, buff beige, off-white, terracotta red, and aged copper green, and present her front, side, and back views to clearly show hair, costume, jewelry, and the sickle, all in a clean, historically grounded anime style.
